[CREATURE:PSYCHOACTIVE_TOAD]
	[CREATURE_CLASS:ALL_CREATURES][DESCRIPTION:A squat amphibian with leathery skin, found in relatively dry areas. Covered in a strong hallucinogenic these toads are prized possessions in kobold camps. Toadlicking is a great pasttime and is said to enhance both spirit and mind. To use the toads extract to its fullest extend the toads can be milked for it. Kobolds skim the sticky covering from the toads skin and bring it to their shamans. Mixed with special mushrooms this can have unpredictable consequences.]
